question: A man driving a car at a speed of 67 km/hr crosses a bridge in 3 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given time directly into hours to find the distance in kilometres.

Time = 3 minutes = 3/60 hours = 1/20 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 67 × (1/20) = 3.35 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.35 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 67 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 3 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 Length of Bridge = Distance
 
 Car
 Speed = 67 km/hr

 Time = 3 minutes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken in hours = 3 ÷ 60

⇒ Time = 1/20 hours

⇒ Length of the bridge = Distance = 67 × (1/20)

⇒ Length of the bridge = 67 ÷ 20

⇒ Length of the bridge = 3.35 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.35 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (v₁ + v₂). When moving in the same direction, it is the difference (v₁ − v₂).

Average Speed

If an object covers equal distances at speeds a and b, the average speed is (2ab) ÷ (a + b). For unequal distances, use Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.
